# Distributions & comparisons

*Describes reflex-silverpoint-react 0.8.0, wrapping silverpoint 0.8.0.*

Each chart's own props, with the JS name the silverpoint MCP tools and the React docs use. The props
every chart shares (`data`, `title`, `height`, `ground`, `palette`, the events…) are in
[SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props); the defaults and notes of each prop come from the
MCP's `get_chart`. In each example the rows live in a `rx.State` field passed as `data`.

<!-- generated:family -->

**14 charts:** [`histogram_chart`](#histogram_chart) · [`ecdf_chart`](#ecdf_chart) · [`box_plot_chart`](#box_plot_chart) · [`violin_chart`](#violin_chart) · [`ridgeline_chart`](#ridgeline_chart) · [`beeswarm_chart`](#beeswarm_chart) · [`lollipop_chart`](#lollipop_chart) · [`dumbbell_chart`](#dumbbell_chart) · [`slope_chart`](#slope_chart) · [`bump_chart`](#bump_chart) · [`error_bar_chart`](#error_bar_chart) · [`interval_chart`](#interval_chart) · [`diverging_bar_chart`](#diverging_bar_chart) · [`connected_scatter_chart`](#connected_scatter_chart)

## histogram_chart

`histogram-chart` · `HistogramChart` · Raw observations binned in the core.

Its own props (the common ones are in [SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props)):

| Python | JS | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `value_key` | `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |
| `bins` | `bins` | `number \| readonly number[]` |
| `cumulative` | `cumulative` | `boolean` |
| `orientation` | `orientation` | `ChartOrientation` |

```python
import reflex as rx
from reflex_silverpoint_react import histogram_chart


class State(rx.State):
    rows: list[dict] = []


def histogram_chart_view() -> rx.Component:
    return histogram_chart(data=State.rows, value_key="minutes", title="Histogram chart", id="histogram-chart")
```

The demo's first rows (read through value_key="minutes"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[{"reader": "R001", "device": "desktop", "minutes": 4}, {"reader": "R002", "device": "phone", "minutes": 17}, {"reader": "R003", "device": "phone", "minutes": 3}]
```
